# betterado_pipeline_approval (Resource)

Records an approval decision for a pending Azure DevOps pipeline run approval.

Because approval decisions cannot be revoked via the API, deleting this resource is a no-op (the resource is simply removed from Terraform state).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "betterado_pipeline_approval" "example" {
  project_id  = "my-project"
  approval_id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001"
  status      = "approved"
  comment     = "Approved by automation"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `approval_id` (String) UUID of the pending approval to resolve. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `project_id` (String) The ID or name of the Azure DevOps project. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `status` (String) The decision to record. Must be `approved` or `rejected`.

### Optional

- `comment` (String) Comment recorded with the approval decision.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The approval ID (same as `approval_id`), stored as the resource identifier.
